title: docs(spec): record:related_list's parentDataSource is described as rendered
body:
Fixes #23585
Clause-②: no

`record:related_list`'s `parentDataSource` is rendered by the console at its pin, and `@objectstack/spec` now says so. Before this change, the key's describe opened with `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, its TSDoc said no renderer reads it, and the liveness `_note` recorded it as planned. All three told an author, an AI author first, not to use a binding the console renders. The change is describe, TSDoc and ledger text only: `RecordRelatedListProps` accepts exactly what it accepted before, no key is added, and every refusal keeps its issue `code` and `path`.

## The new describe, verbatim

> The PARENT record this related list hangs off, bound by a query of its own: an object binding `{ object, view?, filter?, sort?, limit? }`, the shape `dataSource` takes. Read by the single-record rule: the FIRST row of the bound set by its `sort` is the parent (declare `limit: 1` to say one row is meant), and when no row answers, the block renders a loud absence, never an empty list, which would read as "this record has no related records". `relationshipValueField` is read on that row. When this key is absent, the record page's record context remains the parent. The node-level `dataSource` on this block keeps its published meaning, the CHILD rows the list draws (it fills `objectName`, `columns`, `filter`, `sort` and `limit`), and is never read as the parent.

Only the marker left. Every sentence after it holds at the pin (P1 below), so no sentence was added or removed.

## P1 — the pin carries the renderer, and the renderer does what each clause says

- `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` is `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`. In `../objectui`, `git merge-base --is-ancestor d81e46043 4016370af3c9` exits 0, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor d81e46043 fe11eb12e5` (objectui `origin/main`) exits 0. An exit 0 proves itself, so no control leg is owed. `git diff --stat 4016370af3 fe11eb12e5` over the two renderer files prints nothing: objectui `main` reads the key the same way.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` records `objectuiSha` `4016370af3…`, and `sdui.manifest.json` lists `parentDataSource` as an input of `record:related_list`. The console this repository builds is built from that pin.
- Every read below is `git show 4016370af3:PATH` in `../objectui`. R is `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/`.
  - **The key is read.** `R record-related-list.tsx:810` `const parentBinding = schema?.parentDataSource;`, handed to `ParentRecordBinding` at `:814`–`:824`.
  - **The FIRST row by its `sort` is the parent.** `R recordBinding.tsx:429` `const params: QueryParams = { $top: 1 };` and `:431` `if (sortKey) params.$orderby = JSON.parse(sortKey);`. The row is read through `useResolvedDataSource` (`:384`), the page's own adapter, so under the caller's identity (module doc `:45`–`:46`).
  - **No row is a loud absence, never an empty list.** `R recordBinding.tsx:475`: when `absent` is given and the settled read has no row, `BoundRecordProvider` returns `absent` in place of its children. The related list passes `absent={NoParentRecord …}` at `R record-related-list.tsx:821`, and `NoParentRecord` (`:772`–`:786`) draws a `role="status"` notice. The absence replaces the children, so no child query is sent. A read the server refuses as forbidden reads the same as no row (`R recordBinding.tsx:449`).
  - **`relationshipValueField` is read on that row.** `R record-related-list.tsx:259`–`:263` reads it on the record context (`ctx?.recordId`, or `ctx?.data[relationshipValueField]`). `BoundRecordProvider` provides the bound row as that context.
  - **Absent, the record page's record is the parent.** `R recordBinding.tsx:274`: when `isElementDataSourceConfig(binding)` is false (no binding), `ParentRecordBinding` returns its children as they are, so the record page's record context still reaches the list.
  - **The node-level `dataSource` is still the CHILD rows.** `R record-related-list.tsx:724`–`:729` maps `columns`, `filter`, `sort` and `limit` onto the list. The parent gate is given the parent binding alone (`R recordBinding.tsx`, `ParentRecordBinding` docblock).
- objectui's own pin, `R __tests__/record-related-list.parentDataSource-12294.test.tsx`, carries a case for each clause: first row by `sort`, `relationshipValueField` on the bound row, no row is the absence with no child query, 403 is the same absence, no `parentDataSource` keeps the page record, and the registration publishes the input.

No describe clause is untrue at the pin, so the prohibition does not apply.

## P2 — the marker and the note were present on `origin/main` `5b14b7f3ad`

`component.zod.ts:1743` (docblock) and `:1747` (describe) carried `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`. `liveness/page.json:3`'s `_note` carried the `PLANNED RECORD (#23134 …)` sentence.

The card's criterion, on this head: `git grep -n "PLANNED — not yet rendered" -- packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` names `:1170` and `:1175` only, both on the `emptyState` description (out of scope, G4). `git grep -c "PLANNED RECORD (#23134" -- packages/spec/liveness/page.json` answers nothing (exit 1).

## P3 — every text here that called `parentDataSource` planned, unread or not rendered

Measured with `git grep -n parentDataSource` and `git grep -n "not yet rendered"` over the whole tree.

Rewritten here:
1. `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, the describe: the marker is gone.
2. The same file, the key's TSDoc: the "PLANNED, not yet read" paragraph is now "RENDERED by the console", naming the read points with the `objectui:` realm marker and the pin. The same docblock said the `api` arm of `dataSource` "is still unrendered". That is false since objectui `c4dd7078ed` (recorded in this ledger's `_note`), so the clause now says why the key takes the object binding only: it is the shape the sibling blocks read, and the shape objectui's parent read takes (`isElementDataSourceConfig` asks the binding for an `object`).
3. `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, `_note`: the `PLANNED RECORD (#23134 …)` sentence is a `LIVE RECORD`, in the form the `ElementApiDataSource` record took when its renderer shipped. It cites the pin and each objectui path with the `objectui:` realm marker.
4. The same file, the `regions` row's component-member read-point list, entry [10]: `record:related_list.parentDataSource (PLANNED)` pointed at the old measurement (objectui `@f0532d8a`, "the record context read"). It now lists the read points at `@4016370af3c9` in the list's own `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL` spelling. The ledger keeps no `parentDataSource` row; this entry is its one piece of `parentDataSource` evidence, so I read it as inside the claim's "the `parentDataSource` row's status, evidence" item. Named here so a reviewer can disagree.
5. `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx:1971`, regenerated by `gen:docs`.
6. `packages/spec/src/ui/component-record-related-list-parent-23134.test.ts`, pin E: it asserted the describe opens with the marker. Re-trued, not deleted: it now asserts that `check-liveness`'s planned matcher (`MARKER_RE.planned`, copied with its source named) reads nothing in the describe, with a DARK case showing the same matcher catches the replaced marker.

Named, not edited:
- `.changeset/pre/23134-related-list-parent-data-source.md:13` and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:2200` ("Planned, not yet rendered"). Both are the consumed changeset and the released entry for `4cc3ff9`. They were true when that release was cut, so they are not factual errors, and both are release-owned.
- `content/docs/**` (hand-written) and `skills/**`: no hit for `parentDataSource`.

## G1–G4

- **G1.** The ledger carries no `parentDataSource` row, so there is no row status to move and no author warning. The liveness record is the `_note` (item 3) and the evidence entry (item 4). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:liveness` exits 0 (in the gate run below).
- **G2.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated` named one stale artifact, `content/docs/references/**`. `gen:docs` rewrote `component.mdx:1971` (1 line). A second `check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". `authorable-surface.base.json` did not move.
- **G3.** `.changeset/23585-related-list-parent-data-source-rendered.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `Clause-②: no`.
- **G4.** At the pin and at objectui `main`, `git grep -n emptyState -- packages/plugin-detail/src` outside tests answers nothing. The renderer for the `:1170`/`:1175` `emptyState` markers (objectui#12932) has not shipped, so those markers are still true.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` on `131a5615e9`: 701 files passed, 21312 tests passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` on `131a5615e9`: exit 0; `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- The pin file alone: 18 passed.
- **Reverse verification, one time.** With the change committed, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the marker back into the describe (anchor 1 → 0, blob `2d039146d858` → `d8a66adf1db4`). The pin file then failed in the expected direction: 1 failed, 17 passed, the failure being E's "no planned marker" case. The tool restored the file: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The merge of `origin/main` (`04669a467e`, `packages/objectql` and `packages/services/service-automation` only) touches no package this diff touches, so the spec suite was not re-run on the merge commit.

## Gates

Run on the final head, `git rev-parse --short HEAD` = `53624a10cf`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; change set from the merge base `04669a467`) derives 111 commands from the 5 changed paths. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe: 111 of 111 exit 0. `--ran` on that record: "111 derived, 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

- A first run on `131a5615e9` recorded six PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3): the two `@objectstack/lint` doc gates, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. After the `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql` closures were built, all six measured on `53624a10cf` and exit 0. That earlier run is not the reading; the one above is.
- Verdict lines on `53624a10cf`: `check:generated` "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"; `check:docs` "227 generated files in sync with packages/spec"; `check:liveness` exit 0 ("1038 live · 1 experimental · 1 live-elsewhere · 112 dead · 23 planned = 1175 classified"); `check:nul-bytes` OK; `check:authorable-surface` exit 0.
- Local-only, outside the derivation: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exit 0.
- Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- The two `emptyState` markers in `component.zod.ts` (`:1170`, `:1175`) stay. Their renderer has not shipped (G4).
- The released `4cc3ff9` text that calls the key planned stays as released (P3, "Named, not edited").
